name: Actor
summary: +1 Cha; Advantage on Deception and Performance while disguised, and convincing mimicry of sounds and voices.

benefits.name: Impersonation
benefits.summary: While disguised, Advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass as that person.
benefits.text: While you are disguised as a real or fictional person, you have Advantage on Charisma (Deception or Performance) checks you make to convince others that you are that person.

benefits.name: Mimicry
benefits.summary: Mimic creature sounds and speech; listeners need a Wisdom (Insight) check vs DC 8 + Cha mod + PB to tell.
benefits.text: You can imitate the sounds other creatures make, including speech. A creature that hears the imitation must succeed on a Wisdom (Insight) check to recognize that it is fake; the DC equals 8 plus your Charisma modifier and Proficiency Bonus.
